headline: Teledyne Gas and Flame Detection Sets a New Design Standard in Scalable Controllers with the MCX32-TP
summary: CYPRESS, Texas, August 05, 2026--Teledyne Gas and Flame Detection, a portfolio of safety instrument businesses of Teledyne Technologies Incorporated (NYSE: TDY), today announced the introduction of its MCX32-TP, an innovative, next-generation gas and flame detection controller designed to meet the growing demands of complex industrial safety systems.

content.title: Teledyne Gas and Flame Detection Sets a New Design Standard in Scalable Controllers with the MCX32-TP

thumbnail.caption: Teledyne Gas and Flame Detection’s MCX32-TP controller is designed for scalable gas and flame detection across complex industrial environments.
